notes: Montgomery County PA + Phoenixville + restricted Philadelphia rooms. Many Montco bars/breweries run JS-only (Wix/Square/GoDaddy) calendars or post only to Facebook/Instagram, so lineups came from live pages, Wayback snapshots (Internet Archive was heavily rate-limited; many snapshot fetches failed), township park-series pages and a few band sites. Ardmore Music Hall is a Montco venue but books mostly national/tribute acts; all of its band bookings are recorded. Philadelphia restriction: at Johnny Brenda's, Kung Fu Necktie and MilkBoy only bands that already appear in the shared census data (other areas' crawls + earlier Philly band list) were recorded; at Chris' Jazz Cafe only named local ensembles. Philadelphia Folk Festival 2026 acts recorded on each day tag shown on its performer page; 2025 acts skipped (no per-act dates). Not reached: Poppy's Tavern (no listings; Bandsintown 403), The Royal Glenside (Wix bot check), Valley Forge Casino (JS), Ortlieb's (Eventbrite widget), Round Guys Underground (site parked), Towamencin/North Wales park lineups (not online). Community bands (Montgomery County Concert Band) skipped. Steel City's archived 2025–26 shows (e.g. 92nd Street, Girls From Mars, John Byrne Band, River Drivers, Kid Davis & the Bullets) have month/day slugs but no reliable year, so they were not recorded.
